[marginalia]
TABLE OF $M_B^n = \sum_1^n B^i = (B^n-1)/(B-1)$, for low positive integer values of B and n. [del]$M_1^n=n$[/del]

Enter B at the top (in red), and n in the left column. Numbers followed by p are primes, or are numbers denoted by p.
If B is one more than a multiple of p, the value of $M_B^n$ is written in green. If not B but $M_B^n$ is one more than a multiple of p, its value is in blue.
[/marginalia]
